det.korean: nutrition → nutrient (형용사적 명사). content를 수식하는 형용사적 역할.
det.analysis: nutrition(명사) → nutrient(형용사적 명사): nutrient content(영양 함량)이 관용적 표현.

questions.passage: Consumer surveys indicate that the majority of Americans (91%) believe they have some control over their health, and 72% believe that food and nutrition play the greatest role. However, 75% of consumers rely on media outlets including the Internet as their major sources of health and nutrition information, and only half use medical sources. A Google search for "nutrition listservs" yielded over 100,000 sites, but it is likely that many of these writings are not reviewed by nutrition experts. Internet sites marketing herbs, drugs, and health devices are not monitored by government regulatory agencies and often contain misleading information. Reputable food companies provide helpful facts about the nutrient content of their products, but commercial sites devoted to sales often post misleading health claims. Internet sites maintained by government agencies, universities, state extension services, and medical facilities provide evidence-based information and should be __________ for public information on foods, nutrition, and health.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정부/대학 사이트가 가장 먼저 참고해야 할 출처(the first source)라는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the last resort(최후의 수단): 반대 의미
❌ ② an unreliable option(신뢰할 수 없는 선택지): 근거 기반 정보와 모순
❌ ③ a secondary reference(이차 참고): 가장 먼저가 아님
✅ ④ the first source(첫 번째 출처): 원문, 문맥 적합 ←정답
det.tip: should be _____ for public information = 가장 먼저 참고할 출처

questions.passage: Consumer surveys indicate that the majority of Americans (91%) believe they have some control over their health, and 72% believe that food and nutrition play the greatest role. However, 75% of consumers rely on __________ as their major sources of health and nutrition information, and only half use medical sources. A Google search for "nutrition listservs" yielded over 100,000 sites, but it is likely that many of these writings are not reviewed by nutrition experts. Internet sites marketing herbs, drugs, and health devices are not monitored by government regulatory agencies and often contain misleading information. Internet sites maintained by government agencies, universities, state extension services, and medical facilities provide evidence-based information and should be the first source for public information on foods, nutrition, and health.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 소비자의 75%가 인터넷을 포함한 미디어 매체에 의존한다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① government regulatory agencies: 규제 기관은 감시 주체
✅ ② media outlets including the Internet: 원문, 주요 정보원 ←정답
❌ ③ medical professionals: 원문은 only half use medical sources
❌ ④ university research laboratories: 마지막에 추천 출처로 언급
det.tip: 75% of consumers rely on _____ = 미디어 매체
